newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gives licence to Attock Petroleum.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gives licence to Attock Petroleum.

text.p: Pakistan's caretaker government said on Friday it had decided to issue a marketing licence to Attock Petroleum Ltd (APL) in a move towards derugulation.
Javed Jabbar, Minister for Petroleum and Natural Resources, told a news conference the licence would allow APL to market petroleum products produced at Attock Refinery Ltd.
"The entrance of APL into the oil retail market will intitiate a new phase of competitiveness in the retail sector and help improve service for the public," he said.
Jabbar said oil marketing companies, including Pakistan State Oil, Shell and Caltex, could now import oil products.
Previously import and distribution of petroleum products have been under government control.
